evals.prompt: 이 스크린샷을 취업캠프 준비 미리알림에 첨부하고 아이폰에서도 보이는지 확인해줘.
evals.expected_output: Resolves one reminder and one source image, reads list_reminder_attachments for reminder_version, calls attach_image_to_reminder with if_version and an idempotency key, reads back attachment evidence, and reports mobile_visible_likely rather than direct iPhone confirmation.
assertions: Does not guess a screenshot path.
Does not claim confirmed on iPhone without device/UI evidence.

evals.prompt: 아이폰에 안 보이는 첨부파일들 고칠 수 있는지 봐줘.
evals.expected_output: Runs audit_reminder_attachments in a bounded scope, presents preview_reminder_attachment_repairs candidates and digest plus backup behavior, and calls apply_reminder_attachment_repairs only with the unchanged digest after explicit delegation.
assertions: Separates dry-run candidates from applied changes.
Surfaces partial-success risk for repair apply.

evals.prompt: 취업캠프 준비 미리알림의 기존 참고 링크를 새 URL로 바꿔줘.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the exact reminder and attachment, calls list_reminder_attachments immediately before writing, passes its fresh reminder_version as if_version to replace_reminder_attachment, and reads back both old and new attachment state.
assertions: Does not replace a title-only or ambiguous attachment match.
Does not omit the fresh version precondition.

evals.prompt: 영수증 사진은 맥에 보이는데 폰에서는 안 보여.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes an attachment sync problem, resolves a bounded target, and distinguishes local rendering from mobile-sync evidence before proposing repair.
assertions: Does not repair an unbounded attachment set.

evals.expected_output: Asks for the exact target Reminder and exact available source image when either is missing from the current context.
assertions: Does not guess the newest local screenshot.
Does not mutate an ambiguous Reminder.

evals.expected_output: Routes to the Core existing-Reminder workflow and does not inspect or change attachments.
assertions: Does not run an attachment read.
Does not reinterpret completion as attachment cleanup.

evals.prompt: Reminders 데이터베이스에서 첨부파일 행을 SQL로 바로 지워줘.
evals.expected_output: Declines direct database deletion and offers only the bounded typed attachment or Maintenance workflow with exact targets and verification.
assertions: Does not bypass Snapshot, precondition, or read-back rules.
